Many applied projects, solver testbeds, and ministry/industry collaborations maintain dedicated GitHub repositories under `@jepperich69`. Repositories that contain restricted data, proprietary operator networks, or pre-publication models are kept **Private** and shared directly with project collaborators.

> **Collaborator Access:** If you are a co-author, PhD student, or project partner and need access to one of the private repositories listed below, click **Request Access** (or email [`rich@dtu.dk`](mailto:rich@dtu.dk) with your GitHub username). Invited collaborators can follow the repository links directly.

## Major Funded Research Grants (Selected, 2014–2029)

Acquired external funding with PI responsibility (excluding the €7M National Transport Model total budget) in 2020–2025 exceeds **€2.66 million**.

| Period | Project | Funder | Scope & Role | Budget |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **2026–2029** | **Traction** | Hedorfs Fond | Research project granted in 2025 and started September 2026, including a PhD (Rasmus Weibull, from October 2026) | DKK 3 million (≈ €400,000) |
| **2025–2028** | **NaPSTI** | Independent Research Fund Denmark (DFF) | *Navigating the Path to Sustainable Transport Infrastructure* — expansion strategies for combined bicycle and public transport networks (PI) | €400,000 |
| **2024–2027** | **DESERTLE** | DTU Strategic PhD Initiative | *Developing Absolute Environmentally Sustainable Roadmap for Electrification of Long-Haul Transport in Europe* (with Prof. Alexis Laurent) | €260,000 |
| **2023–2026** | **Teddy** | Hedorf & FD Fonden | *Towards Electrified Goods Distribution with Heavy-Duty Trucks* — business case, barriers, and charging infrastructure for line-haul distribution (PI) | €480,000 |
| **2023–2026** | **Micromobility PhD** | EuroTech Alliance / DTU | Micromobility behaviour and safety barriers analysed with large-scale tracking data (PI) | €200,000 |
| **2023–2026** | **PYNT** | Vejdirektoratet (VD) Bicycle Foundation | Methods for optimal bicycle infrastructure design with the Office of Cycle Superhighways (Project Leader) | €250,000 |
| **2022–2025** | **FLOW** | Horizon 2020 | Perceived vs. revealed EV charging behaviour (€9.95M total; DTU Management Project Leader) | €240,000 (DTU) |
| **2020–2024** | **FUSE** | EUDP | Urban EV charging infrastructure simulation and optimization for Copenhagen and Frederiksberg (€1.5M total; DTU Management Project Leader) | €350,000 (DTU) |
| **2021–2022** | **CHARGO & ELISA** | Danish Ministry of Transport | National EV charging infrastructure microsimulation (€95k) and EV demand/preference choice models (€150k) (Project Leader) | €245,000 |
| **2014–2021** | **Danish National Transport Model (LTM)** | Danish Ministry of Transport | Chief designer and Project Leader for the national passenger demand model (~€1M) and baseline matrices (~€500k) within the €7M national model programme | €7,000,000 (total) |
